question: Srimanta Sankardev is generally acknowledged with pioneering new musical, dramatic, and linguistic forms. He is associated with which of the following dance forms?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sattriya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Srimanta Sankardev** was a** 15th-century** saint, poet, and social reformer from **Assam, India**.
 
• He is considered to be the father of the Sattriya dance form, which originated in the monasteries (sattras) founded by him.
